headline: Absa Bank Kenya Allocates Sh230 Million Seed Capital to Global Investment Fund
summary: Absa Bank Kenya launched a new multi-asset global fund targeting Kenyan investors, supporting the product with Sh230 million in seed capital.
why: Absa Bank Kenya is a major commercial bank listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange, providing wealth management services.

impacts.name: Absa Bank Kenya
impacts.why: Absa Kenya allocated Sh230 million seed capital to launch international multi-asset funds.
